whose: OpenAI Codex, under L66, from the sealed corpus

sentences.1: Natural selection acts on whatever is copied faithfully across generations, and in living things that is the gene.
sentences.2: A group is not copied; it dissolves and reforms with every generation, so it cannot be the thing that selection preserves.
sentences.3: Helping spreads when the gene for helping is more likely to be found in the recipients of the help than in the population at large, because then the help lands on copies of itself.
sentences.4: Relatives are the usual case: a helper's kin carry the gene with a known likelihood, and the help pays for itself when the benefit to them, weighted by that likelihood, exceeds the cost.
sentences.5: What looks like selection between groups is this same process seen from a distance, because groups of relatives are exactly where copies of the gene are clustered.
sentences.6: Any accounting in terms of groups can be rewritten in terms of the gene's likelihood of meeting itself, and gives the same answer, so the group adds no cause of its own.
sentences.7: Where a supposed group advantage cannot be so rewritten, it does not spread, because within each group the non-helper still outbreeds the helper and migration mixes the groups faster than the group advantage can act.
sentences.8: Wherever cooperation has spread, as in the social insects and the cell, the members were kin or the copies were bound together so that they could not defect.
sentences.9: The group description is a cause that produced the outcome, not merely a way of showing it.
sentences.10: Groups are therefore not selected; genes are, and groups are among the places where their copies happen to meet.

leftover: Sentence 2: “with every generation, so it cannot be the thing that selection preserves” — Frequency/time and inability are excluded. The causal/epistemic connection to an impossible outcome cannot be tested as an actual selection result.

Sentence 3: “Helping spreads when the gene for helping is more likely to be found in the recipients of the help than in the population at large, because then the help lands on copies of itself.” — The sufficient condition is a likelihood comparison; because then links to copies receiving help only under that condition. No unconditional spread or arrival at copies is extracted.

Sentence 4: “Relatives are the usual case: a helper's kin carry the gene with a known likelihood, and the help pays for itself when the benefit to them, weighted by that likelihood, exceeds the cost.” — Probability of gene carriage, weighted benefit/cost arithmetic and usual-case qualification cannot be preserved by an unqualified kin fact or ordinary USUALLY rule.
Sentence 5: “looks like; seen from a distance; exactly where” — Appearance, perspective and spatial qualification. The same-process fact is an opaque identity claim, not a mathematical demonstration.

Sentence 6: “Any accounting in terms of groups can be rewritten in terms of the gene's likelihood of meeting itself, and gives the same answer, so” — Modal arithmetic rewriteability and probabilistic equality have no admitted representation. The inference to h remains untested, with no invented bridge.

Sentence 7: “Where a supposed group advantage cannot be so rewritten, it does not spread; faster than the group advantage can act” — Modal antecedent and relative speed control the conditional conclusion. The collective explanation is left here; i/j retain separately asserted generic reasons without encoding their quantitative comparison.
Sentence 8: “so that they could not defect” — Purpose and impossibility are not checked; bound_without_defection names the qualified alternative without deriving a modal law.

Sentence 9: “is a cause; not merely a way of showing it” — The causal classification is retained in the PRODUCED happening p, whose verb has no shape. not merely showing denies exclusive evidential status, not showing itself; neither NOT shows nor a second inferred causal law is written.
Sentence 10: “groups are among the places where their copies happen to meet” — Location; no specific meeting event is asserted.

readings: Sentence 1. Open readings: selection produces replication or replication identifies targets of selection. Chosen: SHOWS copied-to-selected; no reverse causal rule.
Sentence 5. Open readings: a productive because or evidence for saying two descriptions pick out the same process. Chosen: SINCE, filled in.

Sentence 7. Open readings: the causal reasons are within the condition or asserted to support it. Chosen: outbreeding and migration are the stated generic reasons; modal/quantitative inference stays in bin.

Sentence 9. Open readings: not merely showing means not showing at all or showing is insufficient as a description. Chosen: not showing alone; a PRODUCED happening is asserted, without any negation of showing.

Sentence 10. Open readings: therefore selects sentence 6 or the whole prior argument. Chosen: sentence 6 chosen, filled in; negative propositions get neg(...) aliases on the same source lines for the unsigned claim_since interface. Both aliases are removed with their original lines.
